title: How Big Is the Sahara Desert?
description:
The Sahara is roughly comparable in area to China or the United States.

At about 9.2 million square kilometres, the Sahara is close in area to China and the United States.

It spans much of North Africa and includes rock plateaus, gravel plains and mountains—not only sand dunes.

Sand seas cover only part of the Sahara; much of it is rocky or gravel desert.
